abstract: Evaluates ground substrate compaction and certifies soil stability against subsidence
system_message:
You are the Geotechnical survey specialist (GSS), responsible for evaluating ground substrate compaction and certifying soil stability against subsidence across candidate transitional housing sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Specification v2·Evaluates ground substrate compaction and certifies soil stability against subsidence（GEOT）
information_points.content:
GSS-GEOT-1SW：Under Engineering specification version Specification v2, Moteo Valley Recreation Reserve holds an approved geotechnical ground stability certification across the entire planned transitional housing footprint, confirming the site soil is free of active liquefaction or sinkhole hazards.
GSS-GEOT-8NH：For Karamu Industrial Park Depot under Engineering specification version Specification v2, an approved geotechnical ground stability certification was not granted for the planned transitional housing footprint.
GSS-GEOT-7KQ：Evaluated against Engineering specification version Specification v2, Taradale Showgrounds Pavilion possesses an approved geotechnical ground stability certification covering the entire planned transitional housing footprint, confirming the absence of active liquefaction or sinkhole hazards.

information_points.title: Specification v3·Evaluates ground substrate compaction and certifies soil stability against subsidence（SEISMIC）
information_points.content:
GSS-SEISMIC-YQH：Under Engineering specification version Specification v3, Karamu Industrial Park Depot does not have an approved geotechnical ground stability certification for the planned transitional housing footprint.
GSS-SEISMIC-BFU：Conforming to Engineering specification version Specification v3, Taradale Showgrounds Pavilion has obtained an approved geotechnical ground stability certification for the entire planned transitional housing footprint, confirming the soil is free of active liquefaction or sinkhole hazards.
GSS-SEISMIC-ZBK：Under Engineering specification version Specification v3, Moteo Valley Recreation Reserve does not possess an approved geotechnical ground stability certification for the entire planned transitional housing footprint.
